answer_1.quote: We focus on the task of open-ended text generation. ... We use GPT-2 small and large, as well as GPT-Neo (small) as our generation models.
answer_1.outputs: Generated continuations up to 512 tokens (or EOS) from prompts.

answer_2.quote: We compute MAUVE scores (where higher implies the samples are closer to the reference text)... We also compute reverse/forward cross-entropy, KL divergence, TVD, and JS divergence as token‑level measures.
